children: Bharti Airtel has become the first telecom operator to roll out voice-and-SMS-only prepaid plans, in line with the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India's (TRAI) new norms, according to sources.
The three plans are priced at ₹185, ₹203 and ₹206. Each offers unlimited local, STD and roaming calls and 300 SMS, but no bundled mobile data. The plans are now listed on the Airtel app and website.

The ₹185 plan, the cheapest of the new offerings, is valid for 28 days. The ₹203 plan runs for 30 days, giving two extra days for ₹18 more. The ₹206 plan is valid for one month, which differs from a fixed 30-day cycle as it renews on the same date each month. All three include free HelloTunes, allowing a new tune to be set every 30 days at no extra cost.
